name: @dsh-fleet/node
description: dsh-fleet node plugin: dials out to a dsh-fleet control plane and serves this machine's /api surface over it
//devDependencies: Built against a LOCAL harness checkout, not npm: the published
@deepseek-ai set is stale (host-apiproxy resolves to 0.0.1-rc.1, whose own
dependency @deepseek-ai/dsh-user-interaction is not in the registry at
all). These links assume deepseek-harness is checked out beside this
repository and has been built with `pnpm run build`.
Runtime resolution is unaffected: a profile gets these packages from the
dsh installation's own module farm, which is why they are peers.
